items.title: "Pete" Ferdinand Valentine Interview, 1960-06-24
items.q: I used to play with him. ... Doc Feller, Thomas.

ctx.x: think was the best clarinet player you ever heard around?

A while. In the old days. I know, I'm talking the old days. Well, it was hard. He was pretty good. And there's a fellow down in the road there by the name of, they call it Thomas. Thomas they call it. Thomas. He's from down in the road there. Thomas man, I used to play with him. I don't know who that is. Doc Feller, Thomas. He stayed in the city a good while. What's his first name, Pa? I know his first name, Thomas, Doc Feller. Is he living there? I don't know if Thomas lives in. Yeah, I think he lives.
That's not the guy they call brother Cornbread, is it?
